gaps.sentence: The festival went ahead ___ the fact that both headliners had cancelled.
gaps.hint: not a cause but a concession
gaps.explanation: The festival happened in spite of the cancellations: despite, not because of.

gaps.sentence: ___ most thrillers, the film reveals the killer in the opening scene.
gaps.explanation: 'Unlike + noun phrase' marks difference from a general category.

gaps.sentence: I will send the report today ___ you asked for it early.
The scheme creates hundreds of jobs. ___, it attracts tourism to the region.
gaps.explanation: 'In addition' introduces another benefit of the scheme.

gaps.sentence: ___ she was utterly exhausted, she stayed to help clear up.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' concedes a known fact: she was exhausted and still stayed.

gaps.sentence: I can't afford a holiday this year; ___, I can't get the time off work.
gaps.explanation: 'Besides' adds a further, often decisive, reason in informal style.

gaps.sentence: It was pouring with rain. ___, the open-air concert went ahead.
gaps.explanation: The concert happened despite the rain: Nevertheless is concessive.

gaps.sentence: No sooner had the applause died ___ the encore began.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner... than' is invariable; 'when' would be wrong here.
